messages:
marie (platform): quick question — for the collector pipeline RFC we keep flipping between: (A) agent-only per-signal pipelines, (B) gateway-only shared pipelines, or (C) hybrid dynamic routing. leaning to C but need concrete routing + quota semantics and what Console needs for rollouts/UI.

ev an (eng-runtime): by hybrid do you mean agent does light prefiltering and gateway owns exporter affinity + retention? that model helps with cross-tenant exporter dedup but complicates backpressure.

marie (platform): exactly. idea is agent performs tenant-aware tagging + prefix cache, gateway does heavy export and long-term retention decisions. also want per-signal control (spans vs metrics vs logs) — different SLOs.

raj (eng-infra): keep in mind egress cost — if gateway fans out too early we pay multiple exporter hits. can we do exporter affinity so certain tenants go direct from agent -> exporter bypassing gateway for high-volume but trusted tenants?

marie (platform): yes. propose policy: route_by = ["latency", "cost", "trust_tier"]. default is gateway for ease of billing. Trusted tenants get agent->exporter direct path.

evan (eng-runtime): to be concrete, here's a config sketch we discussed earlier:```yaml
collector:
  pipelines_per_signal: true
  routing:
    default: gateway
    rules:
      - match: tenant.trust == high
        action: direct_export
      - match: signal == spans and sample_rate < 0.01
        action: gateway_batch
      - match: cost_center == internal
        action: agent_cache_then_gateway
```

sahil (observability): we'll need metrics emitted at three points: agent-routing_decision{rule}, gateway_fanout_count, exporter_skipped_by_affinity. add histogram for agent->gateway latency. Console dashboards should show routing distribution and cost delta for direct vs gateway.

kim (product): from a UX POV the rollout controls should let SREs: toggle per-tenant routing, preview affected tenants, and run canary for X% of traffic. also need an obvious fallback to gateway if direct exporters fail.

dario (eng-platform): on fallback: prefer automatic fallback with backoff and circuit breaker per-exporter. canary semantics: add a rollout object in Console with fields {target_pct, match_rules, start_ts, rollback_on_errors}. we can reuse the existing rollout API but expose a routing preview panel.

raj (eng-infra): retention policy interaction: if agent sends direct to exporter we must still enforce tenant retention controls (e.g., TTL overrides). either exporters must honor TTL headers or gateway retains a copy for compliance — both expensive. need legal input.

marie (platform): good point. propose: for high-trust direct exports we attach signed TTL header and also mirror a sampled copy via gateway for audit retention (configurable). mirrors default to 0.1% to control cost.

evan (eng-runtime): implementation caveat: sampled mirror means extra CPU on gateway. we should make sampling adaptive based on tenant class. codewise we can extend the routing engine to emit decision metadata and an api: `POST /routing/decision` for observability hooks.

sahil (observability): +1 for decision metadata. also need an eval job that validates routing policy doesn't regress latency SLOs or spike egress. put this into the CI check for rollout PRs.

ops-bot: CI / pr-status: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/collector/pull/1492|collector PR #1492> — tests: routing-engine unit tests passed, integration flaky (1/3).

marie (platform): thanks. action items: evan to update routing-engine PR with TTL header + decision endpoint, raj to write exporter-affinity cost model, sahil to draft dashboard panels and CI eval job, dario to prototype Console rollout preview. i'll coordinate legal on retention mirroring. aiming for canary next week.

dario (eng-platform): I'll also add a small UX mock for the preview that shows "estimated egress delta" and list of sample tenants. posting in #design after lunch.

evan (eng-runtime): will push the updated PR later today, will mark TODOs in code for adaptive mirror sampling.

marie (platform): perfect — if anyone wants to review the config sketch above, comment on the PR. short thread but we should capture this in the RFC doc.

raj (eng-infra): adding cost spreadsheet and retention constraints to the RFC now.

kim (product): I'll add the rollout UX requirements to the product ticket and sync with support so they can prepare explainer docs. :thumbsup:

sahil (observability): posting the dashboard wireframes in #obs-dashboards. need one more metric: routing_rule_hit_rate per rule.

marie (platform): great. thanks everyone.
